output.summary: The packet states 95.0% sensitivity and 99.4% specificity. With a 10.0% fraud base rate in live traffic (1,000 fraudulent/9,000 legitimate), the actual fraud capture rate is 95% of 1,000 = 950 fraudulent accounts. The false-positive rate is 0.6%, yielding 54 false positives (0.6% of 9,000). Total suspensions = 950 + 54 = 1,004. Fraud proportion = 950/1,004 ≈ 94.6%, which exceeds the 40% requirement. All constraints are satisfied.
key_claims: 94.6% fraud proportion in suspensions (950 fraud / 1,004 total)
